component.name: Tinkjam Sync
component.summary: Connects the agents on this computer to your Tinkjam boards

description.p: Tinkjam Sync lets your Tinkjam boards use the coding agents installed on this computer, such as Claude Code or Codex. The agents run here, on your own sign-in, and only you can send them work.

On first start it downloads what it needs, then asks you to approve this computer in your browser. After that it runs in the background, starts when you log in and keeps itself up to date. Its icon in the tray shows whether this computer is connected.
